mentions.name: assertmail.com
mentions.description: An API-driven disposable inbox service for integration testing, offering a minimal feature set at a lower price point than the incumbent provider.
mentions.problem: The incumbent API-driven inbox service removed its free tier and has many features unneeded for simple integration testing.
mentions.source_excerpt: We were using an API driven inbox service at dayjob and they nuked their free tier. Their service has so many features we don't need for our simple integration test I thought I could probably compete on price and a minimum feature set.

evidence.value: We were using an API driven inbox service at dayjob and they nuked their free tier. Their service has so many features we don't need for our simple integration test I thought I could probably compete on price and a minimum feature set.
